<h2 class="case-study-title">

Reporting beyond the written story.

</h2>

<p>For this partner journalism project, our team reported on Innovation Brew Works and developed a multimedia story combining written reporting with visual and video elements.</p>

<p>The project gave me experience translating reporting into multiple formats and thinking about how video, visuals, and written storytelling can work together to communicate a story online.</p>
